correctness.rationale: For \(S=h+i\), \(S'=-\mu h-\delta i\le-mS\) gives \(S(t)\le e^{-mt}\) and \(q(t)=c_1h+c_2i\le c_+e^{-mt}\). The exact integrating-factor identity \(p(t)=p_0e^{-\rho t}-R(t)\) then gives the unique threshold equation and \(R(t_c)\to0\) as \(p_0\to\infty\), proving the logarithmic clock. When \(\rho=0\), total consumption is at most \(c_+/m\). In the large-buffer limit \(\lambda(p)=\alpha+O(p_0^{-1})\) uniformly; dominated convergence reduces the integrated health dynamics to the constant-coefficient \(2\times2\) system, whose inverse gives \(\int h=(\gamma+\delta)/D\) and \(\int i=\alpha/D\). This reconstructs the claimed \(J_\alpha\).
